name: HierText: Hierarchical Scene Text Detection and Layout Analysis Benchmark
description: HierText is a benchmark dataset for hierarchical scene text detection, reading order extraction, and document layout analysis in natural scenes, introduced by Google Research at CVPR 2022. Comprising 11,639 high-resolution images sampled from Open Images v6 (constrained to 1600 pixels long side to capture small and fine text), HierText introduces hierarchical ground truth that simultaneously defines word-level tight polygons, line-level oriented bounding boxes, and paragraph-level grouping masks. The dataset contains 8,281 training images, 1,724 validation images, and 1,634 test images, advancing OCR from isolated word bounding boxes toward unified full-page text understanding.
